noise_provenance.caveat: iid-noise-on-smooth-trend assumption; single-trajectory; the sqrt(2) paired scaling is an independence UPPER bound (paired same-seed arms share common-mode noise, which only shrinks it)
noise_provenance.estimator: second-difference: sigma = sqrt(mean(d2^2)/6); robust variant median(|d2|)/(0.6745*sqrt(6)); the LARGER is used

power_context.hwm: adverse prior (v9c2 launch.sh header): dS ceiling 0.012-0.024 => d_seg ceiling 1.2e-4..2.4e-4 = 4.7x..9.4x h95(k=4) — a >=21% capture of the LOW ceiling is detectable
power_context.step: no measured prior effect size (never-fired lever); the design detects |delta d_seg| >= h95(k=4) (~0.74% of trunk d_seg 0.003458)

rules.FIRED-HURTS: mean(primary delta) >= +h95(k=4) (secondary confirmation same as PAYS, opposite sign)
rules.FIRED-PAYS: mean(primary delta) <= -h95(k=4); confirm sign holds on the secondary mean (|secondary| >= h95(k=10) with the same sign)
rules.INDETERMINATE: primary and secondary disagree in sign at threshold — report both, no verdict; extension arm required
rules.derivation_note: 1.959963985 = 95% two-sided standard-normal quantile; no round-number constants (constants-are-poison)
rules.metric: delta(ep) = d_seg_ON(ep) - d_seg_OFF(ep) on paired verdict rows
